g.text: Terminal artifacts only. The same repeat number across n is not a paired trial. Scores use each row's own anchors.
F = invalid candidate M = missing terminal (developer OOM) A = workflow excluded NS = not scheduled
* = recorded early stop (MAPDN/PowerGym) ~ = originally timed out, valid on uniform HEFTCom regrade
